modules.label: core/domain
modules.description: The basic building blocks: money, spending rules, decisions, records, consent and disputes.
modules.cmd: uv run ruff check core/domain && uv run python -m compileall -q core/domain

modules.label: core/policy
modules.description: The decision maker: fixed rules that say allow, ask the person, or block. No AI inside.
modules.cmd: uv run ruff check core/policy && uv run python -m compileall -q core/policy

modules.label: core (ports, settings, services)
modules.description: Shared business logic: settings, payments, disputes, evidence and the background job queue.
modules.cmd: uv run ruff check core --extend-exclude core/domain,core/policy,core/signals && uv run python -m compileall -q -l core

modules.label: core/signals
modules.description: The warning-sign checks, including the AI check that the cart matches what the person asked for.
modules.cmd: uv run ruff check core/signals && uv run python -m compileall -q core/signals

modules.label: adapters/memory
modules.description: Stand-in versions of the database, AI and payment provider, used in tests and the demo.
modules.cmd: uv run ruff check adapters/memory && uv run python -m compileall -q adapters/memory

modules.label: adapters/postgres
modules.description: Saves and loads everything in the database, kept separate for each business.
modules.cmd: uv run ruff check adapters/postgres && uv run python -m compileall -q adapters/postgres

modules.label: adapters/claude
modules.description: Talks to the Claude AI model and logs what each call cost and how long it took.
modules.cmd: uv run ruff check adapters/claude && uv run python -m compileall -q adapters/claude

modules.label: adapters/razorpay
modules.description: Talks to Razorpay, the payment provider, in test mode only.
modules.cmd: uv run ruff check adapters/razorpay && uv run python -m compileall -q adapters/razorpay

modules.label: adapters/otel
modules.description: Sends timing and tracing data to the monitoring tools.
modules.cmd: uv run ruff check adapters/otel && uv run python -m compileall -q adapters/otel

modules.label: adapters/webhooks
modules.description: Sends signed updates to the businesses that use the service.
modules.cmd: uv run ruff check adapters/webhooks && uv run python -m compileall -q adapters/webhooks

modules.label: adapters (gateways, rails)
modules.description: Picks which AI model and payment provider to use, based on the settings.
modules.cmd: uv run ruff check adapters/gateways.py adapters/rails.py adapters/system_clock.py && uv run python -m compileall -q -l adapters

modules.label: agents
modules.description: The AI helper that writes the dispute summary from the collected facts.
modules.cmd: uv run ruff check agents && uv run python -m compileall -q agents

modules.label: workflows (Temporal)
modules.description: Background jobs that wait for a person's answer and build the dispute case.
modules.cmd: uv run ruff check workflows && uv run python -m compileall -q workflows

modules.label: api (FastAPI)
modules.description: The web service that agents and businesses call, plus the admin commands.
modules.cmd: uv run ruff check api && uv run python -m compileall -q api

modules.label: demo (Scenarios, step engine, CLI)
modules.description: The demo stories (one file each) and the step engine that plays them, with a command-line tool that runs them against a live server.
modules.cmd: uv run ruff check demo && uv run python -m compileall -q demo

modules.label: guard_mcp (MCP server)
modules.description: The MCP server an agent's app launches, so the agent can ask for a decision before it pays. It only calls the web service, with a key that can't approve anything.
modules.cmd: uv run ruff check guard_mcp && uv run python -m compileall -q guard_mcp

modules.label: demo_runner (Demo runner)
modules.description: The small server behind the website's demo page. It plays a demo story one step at a time, holding the demo account's keys so the browser never does.
modules.cmd: uv run ruff check demo_runner && uv run python -m compileall -q demo_runner

modules.label: web (Next.js)
modules.description: The website: the consent screen, the dispute viewer, the ops scorecard and the How it works map.
modules.cmd: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build

modules.label: ruff format
modules.description: Checks that all the Python code is formatted the standard way.
modules.cmd: uv run ruff format --check .

modules.label: mypy --strict
modules.description: Checks that the Python code's types all fit together.
modules.cmd: uv run mypy

modules.label: golden evals
modules.description: Runs every hand-labelled test case and fails if any decision comes out wrong.
modules.cmd: uv run ruff check evals && uv run python -m evals.run_evals

modules.label: pytest
modules.description: Runs the full automated test suite. Needs the local database and services running.
modules.cmd: uv run pytest

modules.label: v1.0.0 ready
modules.description: Everything above has passed, so the release is good to go.
